data.why: The app has no file upload widget; forward/reverse primer sequences and the optional template are pasted as plain text into text areas, so the example values from examples/README.md and examples/synthetic_template.fasta are provided as plain text files for the browser agent to copy into the form.

goals: Screen a candidate forward/reverse primer pair against editable thresholds for length, GC%, Tm, hairpin/homodimer/heterodimer Tm, homopolymer runs, Tm difference, and 3' GC count
Adjust assay conditions (monovalent salt, divalent salt, dNTP concentration, primer concentration) to match a specific reaction and see how Tm estimates change
Identify which metrics fall outside lab-specific screening limits and review the resulting warnings before ordering primers
Check for an exact, inward-facing amplicon on a supplied template sequence as a limited specificity sanity check
Export a JSON and HTML report plus a JSON copy of the threshold settings to keep with experimental records

review.summary: The tree follows the README's stated workflow and the app's real layout closely. Twelve sampled screens all support their nodes, and an independent replay confirms every task and feature. It needs light edits before filing: one wrong general term ('probes'), a goal that claims more than the README does, a missing handoff to genome-wide specificity checking, and some framework-control actions that should be cut.
